summary: The generalized bottom-up ladder promotes n=6 after a morphology-derived modal seed, bounded exact-model continuation, full-rank endpoint Gauss--Newton refinement, Box-FDDP feedback, and a 20/20 uninterrupted noisy gate. This is solver-development evidence, not a new public record claim.

deterministic_backbone.modal_seed: regularized minimum-energy finite-horizon controllability solve on the exact hanging linearization
deterministic_backbone.bounded_residual: 48 smooth action-correction knots around the full-resolution morphology-derived controller
deterministic_backbone.action_contract: all candidates and saved routes use the float32 env.step boundary

endpoint_refinement.method: damped minimum-norm Gauss--Newton with exact serial finite-difference sensitivities and rail-aware line search

feedback_repair.feedback: time-varying Box-FDDP gains at full scale
feedback_repair.route_library: optimized route plus exact planar mirror

rail_interpretation.status: passing upper bound, not a minimum-rail certificate

scope_boundary: This promotes the canonical uniform n=6 development rung. It does not establish a universal solver for arbitrary unequal morphologies or n>=8.
next_stage: back-check n=1..7 and apply the morphology-derived synthesis path to unequal chains and n=8
